verses.original: וַיָּקָם֩ אַחֲרֵ֨י אֲבִימֶ֜לֶךְ לְהוֹשִׁ֣יעַ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל תּוֹלָ֧ע בֶּן־ פּוּאָ֛ה בֶּן־ דּוֹד֖וֹ אִ֣ישׁ יִשָּׂשכָ֑ר וְהֽוּא־ יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּשָׁמִ֖יר בְּהַ֥ר אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām ’a·ḥă·rê ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ lə·hō·wō·šî·a‘ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl tō·w·lā‘ ben- pū·’āh ben- dō·w·ḏōw ’îš yiś·śā·š·ḵār wə·hū- yō·šêḇ bə·šā·mîr bə·har ’ep̄·rā·yim
verses.literal: After the time of Abimelech a man of Issachar Tola son of Puah the son of Dodo rose up to save Israel He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim
verses.literalPt: E DEPOIS de Abimeleque, se levantou, para livrar a Israel, Tola, filho de Puá, filho de Dodo, homem de Issacar; e habitava em Samir, na montanha de Efraim.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְשָׁלֹ֖שׁ שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּ֖מָת וַיִּקָּבֵ֥ר בְּשָׁמִֽיר׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·pōṭ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘eś·rîm wə·šā·lōš šā·nāh way·yā·māṯ way·yiq·qā·ḇêr bə·šā·mîr
verses.literal: Tola judged Israel twenty-three . . . years and when he died he was buried in Shamir
verses.literalPt: E julgou a Israel vinte e três anos; e morreu, e foi sepultado em Samir.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קָם אַחֲרָ֔יו יָאִ֖יר הַגִּלְעָדִ֑י וַיִּשְׁפֹּט֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁתַּ֖יִם שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām ’a·ḥă·rāw yā·’îr hag·gil·‘ā·ḏî way·yiš·pōṭ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘eś·rîm ū·šə·ta·yim šā·nāh
verses.literal: Tola was followed by Jair the Gileadite who judged Israel twenty-two . . . years
verses.literalPt: E depois dele se levantou Jair, gileadita, e julgou a Israel vinte e dois anos.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־ ל֞וֹ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּנִ֗ים רֹֽכְבִים֙ עַל־ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים עֲיָרִ֔ים וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים עֲיָרִ֖ים לָהֶ֑ם לָהֶ֞ם יִקְרְא֣וּ׀ חַוֺּ֣ת יָאִ֗יר עַ֚ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֶ֥רֶץ הַגִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî- lōw šə·lō·šîm bā·nîm rō·ḵə·ḇîm ‘al- šə·lō·šîm ‘ă·yā·rîm ū·šə·lō·šîm ‘ă·yā·rîm lā·hem lā·hem yiq·rə·’ū ḥaw·wōṯ yā·’îr ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh ’ă·šer bə·’e·reṣ hag·gil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkeys And they had thirty towns - in the land of Gilead which to this day are called Havvoth-jair
verses.literalPt: E tinha este trinta filhos, que cavalgavam sobre trinta jumentos; e tinham trinta cidades, a que chamaram Havote-Jair, até ao dia de hoje; as quais estão na terra de Gileade.

verses.literal: When Jair died he was buried in Kamon
verses.literalPt: E morreu Jair, e foi sepultado em Camom.

verses.original: וַיֹּסִ֣פוּ׀ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת הָרַע֮ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ וַיַּעַבְד֣וּ אֶת־ הַבְּעָלִ֣ים וְאֶת־ הָעַשְׁתָּר֡וֹת וְאֶת־ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲרָם֩ וְאֶת־ אֱלֹהֵ֨י צִיד֜וֹן וְאֵ֣ת׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י מוֹאָ֗ב וְאֵת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י בְנֵי־ עַמּ֔וֹן וְאֵ֖ת אֱלֹהֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיַּעַזְב֥וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א עֲבָדֽוּהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·si·p̄ū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh way·ya·‘aḇ·ḏū ’eṯ- hab·bə·‘ā·lîm wə·’eṯ- hā·‘aš·tā·rō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·rām wə·’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣî·ḏō·wn wə·’êṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê mō·w·’āḇ wə·’êṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê ḇə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn wə·’êṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê p̄ə·liš·tîm way·ya·‘az·ḇū ’eṯ- Yah·weh wə·lō ‘ă·ḇā·ḏū·hū
verses.literal: And again the Israelites . . . did evil in the sight of the LORD They served the Baals the Ashtoreths the gods of Aram Sidon and . . . Moab and the gods of the Ammonites . . . - and Philistines Thus they forsook the LORD and did not serve Him
verses.literalPt: Então tornaram os filhos de Israel a fazer o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, e serviram aos baalins, e a Astarote, e aos deuses da Síria, e aos deuses de Sidom, e aos deuses de Moabe, e aos deuses dos filhos de Amom, e aos deuses dos filisteus; e deixaram ao SENHOR, e não o serviram.

verses.original: וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיִּמְכְּרֵם֙ בְּיַד־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וּבְיַ֖ד בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḥar- ’ap̄ Yah·weh bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·yim·kə·rêm bə·yaḏ- pə·liš·tîm ū·ḇə·yaḏ bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn
verses.literal: So the anger of the LORD burned against Israel and He sold them into the hands of the Philistines . . . and Ammonites . . .
verses.literalPt: E a ira do SENHOR se acendeu contra Israel; e vendeu-os nas mãos dos filisteus, e nas mãos dos filhos de Amom.

verses.original: וַֽיִּרְעֲצ֤וּ וַיְרֹֽצְצוּ֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּשָּׁנָ֖ה הַהִ֑יא שְׁמֹנֶ֨ה עֶשְׂרֵ֜ה שָׁנָ֗ה אֶֽת־ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן בְּאֶ֥רֶץ הָאֱמֹרִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּגִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·‘ă·ṣū way·rō·ṣə·ṣū ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl baš·šā·nāh ha·hî šə·mō·neh ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh ’eṯ- kāl- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên bə·’e·reṣ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ’ă·šer bag·gil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: who that very year harassed and oppressed the Israelites . . . and they did so for eighteen . . . years to all the Israelites . . . on the other side of the Jordan in Gilead the land of the Amorites
verses.literalPt: E naquele mesmo ano oprimiram e vexaram aos filhos de Israel; dezoito anos oprimiram a todos os filhos de Israel que estavam além do Jordão, na terra dos amorreus, que está em Gileade.

verses.original: וַיַּעַבְר֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ עַמּוֹן֙ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן לְהִלָּחֵ֛ם גַּם־ בִּיהוּדָ֥ה וּבְבִנְיָמִ֖ין וּבְבֵ֣ית אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַתֵּ֥צֶר לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aḇ·rū ḇə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên lə·hil·lā·ḥêm gam- bî·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇə·ḇin·yā·mîn ū·ḇə·ḇêṯ ’ep̄·rā·yim wat·tê·ṣer lə·yiś·rā·’êl mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: The Ammonites . . . also crossed the Jordan to fight against Judah Benjamin and the house of Ephraim and Israel was in deep distress
verses.literalPt: Até os filhos de Amom passaram o Jordão, para pelejar também contra Judá, e contra Benjamim, e contra a casa de Efraim; de modo que Israel ficou muito angustiado.

verses.original: וַֽיִּזְעֲקוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר חָטָ֣אנוּ לָ֔ךְ וְכִ֤י עָזַ֙בְנוּ֙ אֶת־ אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ וַֽנַּעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־ הַבְּעָלִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·‘ă·qū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’el- Yah·weh lê·mōr ḥā·ṭā·nū lāḵ wə·ḵî ‘ā·zaḇ·nū ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū wan·na·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- hab·bə·‘ā·lîm
verses.literal: Then the Israelites . . . cried out to the LORD saying We have sinned against You for we have indeed forsaken our God and served the Baals
verses.literalPt: Então os filhos de Israel clamaram ao SENHOR, dizendo: Contra ti havemos pecado, visto que deixamos a nosso Deus, e servimos aos baalins.

verses.original: וַ֥יֹּאמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֲלֹ֤א מִמִּצְרַ֙יִם֙ וּמִן־ הָ֣אֱמֹרִ֔י וּמִן־ בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן וּמִן־ פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hă·lō mim·miṣ·ra·yim ū·min- hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ū·min- bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ū·min- pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: The LORD replied When the Egyptians . . . Amorites . . . Ammonites . . . . . . Philistines
verses.literalPt: Porém o SENHOR disse aos filhos de Israel: Porventura dos egípcios, e dos amorreus, e dos filhos de Amom, e dos filisteus,

verses.original: וְצִידוֹנִ֤ים וַֽעֲמָלֵק֙ וּמָע֔וֹן לָחֲצ֖וּ אֶתְכֶ֑ם וַתִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֵלַ֔י וָאוֹשִׁ֥יעָה אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִיָּדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣî·ḏō·w·nîm wa·‘ă·mā·lêq ū·mā·‘ō·wn lā·ḥă·ṣū ’eṯ·ḵem wat·tiṣ·‘ă·qū ’ê·lay wā·’ō·wō·šî·‘āh ’eṯ·ḵem mî·yā·ḏām
verses.literal: Sidonians Amalekites and Maonites oppressed you and you cried out to Me did I not save you from their hands
verses.literalPt: E dos sidônios, e dos amalequitas, e dos maonitas, que vos oprimiam, quando a mim clamastes, não vos livrei das suas mãos?

verses.original: וְאַתֶּם֙ עֲזַבְתֶּ֣ם אוֹתִ֔י וַתַּעַבְד֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים לָכֵ֥ן לֹֽא־ אוֹסִ֖יף לְהוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.literal: But you have forsaken Me and served other gods so I will no longer save you
verses.literalPt: Contudo vós me deixastes a mim, e servistes a outros deuses; pelo que não vos livrarei mais.

verses.original: לְכ֗וּ וְזַֽעֲקוּ֙ אֶל־ הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּחַרְתֶּ֖ם בָּ֑ם הֵ֛מָּה יוֹשִׁ֥יעוּ לָכֶ֖ם בְּעֵ֥ת צָרַתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵū wə·za·‘ă·qū ’el- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer bə·ḥar·tem bām hêm·māh yō·wō·šî·‘ū lā·ḵem bə·‘êṯ ṣā·raṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: Go and cry out to the gods you have chosen Let them save you in your time of trouble
verses.literalPt: Ide, e clamai aos deuses que escolhestes; que eles vos livrem no tempo do vosso aperto.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ חָטָ֔אנוּ עֲשֵׂה־ אַתָּ֣ה לָ֔נוּ כְּכָל־ הַטּ֖וֹב בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ אַ֛ךְ הַצִּילֵ֥נוּ נָ֖א הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’el- Yah·weh ḥā·ṭā·nū ‘ă·śêh- ’at·tāh lā·nū kə·ḵāl- haṭ·ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ’aḵ haṣ·ṣî·lê·nū nā hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: We have sinned the Israelites . . . said to the LORD Deal . . . with us . . . as You see fit but please deliver us today . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas os filhos de Israel disseram ao SENHOR: Pecamos; faze-nos conforme a tudo quanto te parecer bem aos teus olhos; tão-somente te rogamos que nos livres nesta vez.

verses.original: וַיָּסִ֜ירוּ אֶת־ אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַנֵּכָר֙ מִקִּרְבָּ֔ם וַיַּעַבְד֖וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וַתִּקְצַ֥ר נַפְשׁ֖וֹ בַּעֲמַ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·sî·rū ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê han·nê·ḵār miq·qir·bām way·ya·‘aḇ·ḏū ’eṯ- Yah·weh wat·tiq·ṣar nap̄·šōw ba·‘ă·mal yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So they put away the foreign gods from among them and served the LORD and He could no longer bear the misery of Israel
verses.literalPt: E tiraram os deuses alheios do meio de si, e serviram ao SENHOR; então se angustiou a sua alma por causa da desgraça de Israel.

verses.original: וַיִּצָּֽעֲקוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּגִּלְעָ֑ד וַיֵּאָֽסְפוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּמִּצְפָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṣ·ṣā·‘ă·qū bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn way·ya·ḥă·nū bag·gil·‘āḏ way·yê·’ā·sə·p̄ū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·ḥă·nū bam·miṣ·pāh
verses.literal: Then the Ammonites . . . were called to arms and camped in Gilead and the Israelites . . . assembled and camped at Mizpah
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Amom se reuniram e se acamparam em Gileade; e também os de Israel se congregaram, e se acamparam em Mizpá.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ הָעָ֜ם שָׂרֵ֤י גִלְעָד֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־ רֵעֵ֔הוּ מִ֣י הָאִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָחֵ֔ל לְהִלָּחֵ֖ם בִּבְנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן יִֽהְיֶ֣ה לְרֹ֔אשׁ לְכֹ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י גִלְעָֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū hā·‘ām śā·rê ḡil·‘āḏ ’îš ’el- rê·‘ê·hū mî hā·’îš ’ă·šer yā·ḥêl lə·hil·lā·ḥêm biḇ·nê ‘am·mō·wn yih·yeh lə·rōš lə·ḵōl yō·šə·ḇê ḡil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: And the rulers of Gilead said . . . to one another Whoever . . . will launch the attack against the Ammonites . . . will be the head of all who live in Gilead
verses.literalPt: Então o povo e os príncipes de Gileade disseram uns aos outros: Quem será o homem que começará a pelejar contra os filhos de Amom? Ele será por cabeça de todos os moradores de Gileade.
